generalDetails.name: SPRAY PUMP - MOTOR
generalDetails.description:
Motor used to operate the spray pump, enabling controlled spraying of fluid in the system.
Supports uniform distribution and ensures efficient process performance.

generalDetails.name: CIRC.PUMP - MOTOR
generalDetails.description: The circulation pump motor is an electric motor used to drive the circulation pump, ensuring continuous movement of fluid throughout the system. It helps maintain a consistent flow rate and pressure, which is essential for proper circulation, effective heat transfer, and overall process stability. The motor is designed for reliable and continuous operation to support uninterrupted system performance.

generalDetails.name: OIL SEPARATOR MOTOR
generalDetails.description: The oil separator motor is an electric motor used to operate the oil separator, enabling effective separation of oil from the process fluid. It ensures efficient removal of oil to maintain fluid quality, improve system performance, and support reliable operation.

generalDetails.name: MAGNETIC SEPARATOR  TRANSFER PUMP
generalDetails.description: The transfer pump is used to move material to and from the magnetic separator, ensuring smooth and continuous flow within the system. It supports efficient separation by maintaining a steady supply of material, helping improve overall process performance and reliability.

generalDetails.name: CIRC.PUMP - MOTOR
generalDetails.description: The circulation pump motor is used to drive the pump that circulates the degreasing solution within the system. It ensures continuous flow of the cleaning fluid, helping in effective removal of oil, grease, and contaminants. This supports uniform cleaning and improves the overall efficiency of the degreasing process.

generalDetails.name: SPRAY PUMP
generalDetails.description: The spray pump is used to deliver the degreasing solution through spray nozzles at required pressure. It ensures uniform distribution of the cleaning fluid over the components, helping in effective removal of oil, grease, and contaminants. This improves cleaning efficiency and overall process performance.

generalDetails.name: CYCLONE DRAIN PUMP
generalDetails.description: The cyclone drain pump is used to remove collected sludge, oil, or separated contaminants from the cyclone separator. It ensures continuous discharge of waste materials, preventing accumulation and supporting smooth and efficient operation of the system.

generalDetails.name: SUMP PIT
generalDetails.description: The sump pit is a collection point used to gather wastewater, sludge, or drainage from the system. It helps in temporary storage and allows for proper removal or pumping of collected fluids, ensuring clean and efficient operation of the process.

generalDetails.name: SPRAY PUMP-WR1
generalDetails.description: The spray pump is used to supply rinse water to the spray nozzles in the first water rinse stage. It ensures uniform distribution of water over the components, helping to remove residual chemicals and contaminants from the previous process. This supports effective rinsing and improves overall cleaning quality.

generalDetails.name: SPRAY PUMP-WR2
generalDetails.description: The spray pump is used to deliver rinse water in the second water rinse stage through spray nozzles. It ensures thorough removal of remaining residues and contaminants, improving the final cleaning quality and overall process efficiency.

generalDetails.name: CIRCULATION PUMP-ACTIVATION
generalDetails.description: The circulation pump is used to circulate the activation solution continuously within the system. It ensures uniform distribution of the solution over components, supporting proper surface activation and improving overall process effectiveness.

generalDetails.name: CONDITIONER
generalDetails.description: The conditioner is used to prepare the surface before the next treatment process by promoting uniform coating or reaction. It helps improve surface quality and ensures better adhesion and effectiveness of subsequent processes.

generalDetails.name: CONDITIONER MIXER
generalDetails.description: The conditioner mixer is used to mix and maintain the conditioner solution uniformly in the tank. It ensures proper blending of chemicals, prevents settling, and supports consistent solution quality for effective surface preparation.

generalDetails.name: PH CONDITION ( PVC )
generalDetails.description: The pH conditioner (PVC tank) is used to adjust and maintain the pH level of the solution within the required range. It ensures proper chemical balance, supporting effective treatment, process stability, and consistent performance.

generalDetails.name: HOT WATER CIRCULATION
generalDetails.description: The hot water circulation system is used to continuously circulate heated water within the phosphate process tank. It helps maintain the required temperature, ensures uniform heat distribution, and supports effective chemical reaction and coating formation for consistent process performance.

generalDetails.name: DUMP TANK TRANSFER PUMP
generalDetails.description: The transfer pump is used to move liquid from the dump tank to the required system or disposal line. It ensures quick and efficient transfer of used or waste solution, helping maintain smooth operation and proper tank management.

generalDetails.name: SPRAY PUMP-PHOSPHATING
generalDetails.description: The spray pump is used to deliver the phosphating solution through spray nozzles at the required pressure. It ensures uniform coating over the components, supporting proper phosphate layer formation and improving corrosion resistance and overall coating quality.

generalDetails.name: SUMP PIT PUMP-1
generalDetails.description: The sump pit pump is used to remove collected wastewater, sludge, or overflow from the sump pit. It ensures continuous drainage and prevents accumulation, supporting clean, safe, and efficient operation of the system.

generalDetails.name: SPRAY PUMP-WR3
generalDetails.description: The spray pump is used to supply rinse water through spray nozzles in the third water rinse stage. It ensures thorough removal of any remaining residues, improving final cleaning quality and preparing components for the next process.

generalDetails.name: SPRAY PUMP-WR4
generalDetails.description: The spray pump is used to deliver rinse water through spray nozzles in the fourth rinse stage. It ensures final removal of residual contaminants and chemicals, improving surface cleanliness and overall process quality.

generalDetails.name: CIRCULATION PUMP-WR5
generalDetails.description: The circulation pump is used to continuously circulate rinse water within the tank in the fifth rinse stage. It helps maintain uniform water quality, improves removal of remaining residues, and supports consistent final rinsing performance.

generalDetails.name: MAIN CIRCULATION  1
generalDetails.description: The main circulation pump is used to continuously circulate the electro coating solution within the system. It maintains uniform bath composition, ensures consistent flow to all sections, and supports stable coating quality and process performance.

generalDetails.name: MAIN COOLING CIRCULATION 2
generalDetails.description: he main cooling circulation system is used to circulate coolant or bath solution to control the temperature in the electro coating process. It helps maintain the required temperature range, prevents overheating, and ensures stable coating quality and consistent system performance.

generalDetails.name: ANOLYTE PUMP
generalDetails.description: The anolyte pump is used to circulate the anolyte solution within the electrocoating system. It helps maintain proper conductivity and pH balance, supporting stable coating conditions and ensuring consistent coating quality.

generalDetails.name: TENSIDE(PCV)_PRE DEGREASE
generalDetails.description: The tenside (PVC) unit is used to store and supply surfactant solution for the pre-degreasing process. It helps loosen oil, grease, and surface contaminants, improving cleaning efficiency and preparing components for further treatment.

generalDetails.name: CLEANER
generalDetails.description: The cleaner is used to remove oil, grease, dirt, and other surface contaminants from components during the cleaning process. It helps ensure proper surface preparation and improves the effectiveness of subsequent treatment and coating processes.

generalDetails.name: TENSIDE ( PVC )_DEGREASE
generalDetails.description: The tenside (PVC) unit is used to store and supply surfactant solution for the degreasing process. It helps break down and remove oil, grease, and contaminants from component surfaces, ensuring effective cleaning and better preparation for further treatment.

generalDetails.name: SUMP PIT PUMP-1
generalDetails.description: The sump pit pump is used to remove collected wastewater, sludge, or overflow from the phosphate process sump pit. It ensures proper drainage, prevents accumulation, and supports clean and efficient operation of the system.

generalDetails.name: FILTER PRESS SUPPLY PUMP
generalDetails.description: The filter press supply pump is used to feed slurry or process liquid to the filter press at the required pressure. It supports efficient solid-liquid separation, helping remove sludge and maintain smooth system operation.

generalDetails.name: ACID DRUM TRANSFER
generalDetails.description: The acid drum transfer pump is used to transfer acid from storage drums to the required tank or dosing system. It ensures safe and controlled handling of acid, supporting smooth chemical supply and efficient process operation.

generalDetails.name: PHOSPHATE E ( PVC ) DOSING
generalDetails.description: he Phosphate E (PVC) dosing unit is used to store and dose phosphate chemical into the process tank at the required quantity. It helps maintain proper chemical concentration, ensuring effective coating formation and consistent process performance.

generalDetails.name: PHOSPHATE A ( PVC ) DOSING
generalDetails.description: The Phosphate A (PVC) dosing unit is used to store and dose phosphate chemical into the process tank as per required quantity. It helps maintain correct chemical balance, ensuring proper coating formation and stable process performance.

generalDetails.name: ACCELERATOR DILLUTION
generalDetails.description: The accelerator dilution unit is used to prepare diluted accelerator solution before dosing into the process tank. It helps maintain the required concentration, ensuring effective chemical reaction and consistent process performance.

generalDetails.name: CIRCULATION PUMP - 1
generalDetails.description: The circulation pump is used to continuously circulate process fluid within the system. It helps maintain uniform solution flow, proper mixing, and consistent process conditions for efficient operation.

generalDetails.name: CIRCULATION PUMP - 2
generalDetails.description: The circulation pump is used to continuously circulate process fluid within the system. It helps maintain steady flow, uniform solution distribution, and stable operating conditions for efficient process performance.

generalDetails.name: MAIN CIRCULATION  1
generalDetails.description: The main circulation pump is used to continuously circulate the e-coating bath solution throughout the system. It helps maintain uniform paint solids distribution, stable bath conditions, and consistent coating quality on components.

generalDetails.name: MAIN COOLING CIRCULATION 2
generalDetails.description: The main cooling circulation pump is used to circulate coolant or process liquid to control system temperature. It helps maintain the required operating temperature, prevents overheating, and supports stable and efficient process performance.

generalDetails.name: DUMP TANK TRANSFER PUMP
generalDetails.description: The dump tank transfer pump is used to transfer used or waste solution from the dump tank to the required storage, treatment, or disposal system. It ensures smooth liquid handling and supports efficient tank maintenance and process operation.

generalDetails.name: DUMP TANK TRANSFER PUMP
generalDetails.description: The dump tank transfer pump is used to transfer used or waste solution from the dump tank to the required storage, treatment, or disposal system. It ensures smooth liquid handling and supports efficient tank maintenance and process operation.

generalDetails.name: ADDITIVE
generalDetails.description: The additive unit is used to store and supply additional chemicals to the process tank as required. It helps maintain proper solution composition, improves process performance, and ensures consistent treatment quality.

generalDetails.name: PIGMENT TRANSFER
generalDetails.description: The pigment transfer pump is used to transfer pigment material to the e-coat bath or storage system. It helps maintain proper paint composition, ensuring uniform color distribution, coating quality, and stable process performance.

generalDetails.name: PIGMENT FEED DOSING
generalDetails.description: The pigment feed dosing unit is used to supply and dose pigment into the process bath at the required quantity. It helps maintain correct paint composition, ensuring uniform color, coating consistency, and stable process performance.

generalDetails.name: RESIN FEED
generalDetails.description: The resin feed unit is used to supply resin to the process bath at the required quantity. It helps maintain proper paint composition, ensuring coating adhesion, film strength, and consistent process performance.

generalDetails.name: RESIN TRANSFER
generalDetails.description: The resin transfer pump is used to transfer resin from storage to the process bath or supply system. It helps maintain proper paint composition, ensuring consistent coating quality and smooth process operation.

generalDetails.name: UF RINSE  SUPPLY PUMP  1
generalDetails.description: The UF rinse supply pump is used to supply ultrafiltration rinse solution to the rinse stage at the required flow and pressure. It helps recover paint solids, improve rinsing efficiency, and maintain coating quality in the e-coating process.

generalDetails.name: UF RINSE CIRCULATION PUMP # 2
generalDetails.description: The UF rinse circulation pump is used to continuously circulate the ultrafiltration rinse solution within the system. It helps maintain uniform solution quality, improves paint recovery, and supports consistent rinsing performance in the e-coating process.

generalDetails.name: UF CIRCULATION PUMP
generalDetails.description: The UF circulation pump is used to continuously circulate the ultrafiltration solution within the system. It helps maintain steady flow through the UF unit, supports efficient filtration, and improves overall process performance in the e-coating system.

generalDetails.name: DI WATER SPRAY PUMP
generalDetails.description: The DI water spray pump is used to supply deionized water through spray nozzles at the required pressure. It ensures final rinsing of components, removes residual contaminants, and improves surface cleanliness before coating or drying.

generalDetails.name: DI WATER SPRAY PUMP
generalDetails.description: The DI water spray pump is used to deliver deionized water through spray nozzles for final rinsing of components. It helps remove remaining residues, prevents contamination, and ensures high surface cleanliness for subsequent coating or drying processes.

generalDetails.name: CIRCULATION PUMP_UF FLUSHING
generalDetails.description: The circulation pump is used to circulate flushing solution through the ultrafiltration system during cleaning operations. It helps remove deposits and contaminants from UF membranes, maintaining filtration efficiency and reliable system performance.

generalDetails.name: UF CLEANER FEEDING PUMP
generalDetails.description: The UF cleaner feeding pump is used to supply cleaning solution to the ultrafiltration system during maintenance or cleaning cycles. It helps remove fouling and deposits from membranes, ensuring efficient filtration and reliable system operation.

generalDetails.name: UF PERMEATE TRANSFER PUMP
generalDetails.description: The UF permeate transfer pump is used to transfer filtered permeate liquid from the ultrafiltration system to the required storage or reuse point. It helps maintain smooth flow, supports water recovery, and improves overall process efficiency.

generalDetails.name: UF PERMEATE TRANSFER PUMP
generalDetails.description: The UF permeate transfer pump is used to transfer permeate liquid from the ultrafiltration unit to storage or reuse systems. It ensures continuous flow, supports efficient water recovery, and maintains smooth operation of the UF process.

generalDetails.name: UF PERMEATE TRANSFER PUMP
generalDetails.description: The UF permeate transfer pump is used to transfer permeate liquid from the ultrafiltration unit to storage or reuse systems. It ensures continuous flow, supports efficient water recovery, and maintains smooth operation of the UF process.

generalDetails.name: MECHA SEAL PUMP
generalDetails.description: The mechanical seal pump is used to prevent leakage while transferring process liquid within the system. It ensures safe and reliable pumping operation, reduces fluid loss, and supports efficient system performance.

generalDetails.name: MECHA SEAL PUMP
generalDetails.description: The mechanical seal pump is used to prevent leakage while transferring process liquid within the system. It ensures safe and reliable pumping operation, reduces fluid loss, and supports efficient system performance.

generalDetails.name: WASTE WATER TRANSFER PUMP
generalDetails.description: The waste water transfer pump is used to transfer wastewater from collection tanks or process areas to the treatment or disposal system. It ensures smooth liquid handling, prevents overflow, and supports efficient waste management operations.

generalDetails.name: EXHAUST FAN_PT ENTRANCE
generalDetails.description: The exhaust fan at the PT entrance is used to remove fumes, vapors, and hot air from the pretreatment area. It helps maintain proper ventilation, improves air quality, and supports a safe working environment.

generalDetails.name: EXHAUST FAN_PT PHOPHATE
generalDetails.description: The exhaust fan at the PT entrance is used to remove fumes, vapors, and hot air from the pretreatment area. It helps maintain proper ventilation, improves air quality, and supports a safe working environment.

generalDetails.name: EXHAUST FAN_WATER RINSE 5
generalDetails.description: The exhaust fan at Water Rinse 5 is used to remove moisture, vapors, and humid air from the rinse stage area. It helps maintain proper ventilation, reduces condensation, and supports a clean and safe working environment.

generalDetails.name: EXHAUST FAN_E-COAT
generalDetails.description: The exhaust fan at the e-coat area is used to remove fumes, vapors, and excess heat generated during the coating process. It helps maintain proper ventilation, improves air quality, and supports safe and efficient operation.

generalDetails.name: SUPPLY FAN_PT INSPECTION
generalDetails.description: The supply fan at the PT inspection area is used to provide fresh air circulation and maintain proper ventilation. It helps improve air quality, control temperature, and create a comfortable working environment for inspection activities.

generalDetails.name: CIRCULATION FAN_ED OVEN -PRE HEAT
generalDetails.description: The circulation fan in the ED oven pre-heat zone is used to circulate hot air uniformly inside the oven. It helps maintain even temperature distribution, improves heating efficiency, and ensures proper pre-heating of components before further processing.

generalDetails.name: CIRCULATION FAN_ED OVEN KEEP
generalDetails.description: The circulation fan in the ED oven keep zone is used to circulate hot air uniformly inside the oven. It helps maintain the required holding temperature, ensures even heat distribution, and supports proper curing of coated components.

generalDetails.name: FRESH AIR INTAKE FAN
generalDetails.description: The fresh air intake fan is used to draw outside air into the system or workspace. It helps maintain proper ventilation, improves air quality, and supports a safe and comfortable working environment by supplying clean fresh air.

generalDetails.name: SUPPLY FAN_COOLING ZONE
generalDetails.description: The supply fan in the cooling zone is used to deliver fresh air for controlled cooling of components after heating or coating processes. It helps reduce temperature gradually, ensures uniform cooling, and supports proper finish quality and process stability.

generalDetails.name: EXHAUST FAN_COOLING ZONE
generalDetails.description: The exhaust fan in the cooling zone is used to remove warm air generated during the cooling process. It helps maintain proper airflow, supports effective temperature control, and ensures uniform and efficient cooling of components.

generalDetails.name: VENTILATION EXHAUST FAN
generalDetails.description: The ventilation exhaust fan is used to remove stale air, fumes, and excess heat from the working area. It helps maintain proper air circulation, improves air quality, and ensures a safe and comfortable working environment.

generalDetails.name: CIRCULATION FAN_HEAT UP
generalDetails.description: The circulation fan in the heat-up zone is used to circulate hot air uniformly inside the system. It helps achieve fast and even temperature rise, improves heating efficiency, and ensures consistent process conditions for components.

generalDetails.name: ACCELERATOR MIXER
generalDetails.description: The accelerator mixer is used to mix and maintain the accelerator solution uniformly in the tank. It helps ensure proper chemical blending, prevents settling, and supports consistent reaction efficiency and stable process performance.

generalDetails.name: ACCELERATOR DILLUTION
generalDetails.description: The accelerator dilution unit is used to prepare diluted accelerator solution before dosing into the process tank. It helps maintain the required concentration, ensures proper chemical reaction, and supports consistent process performance.

generalDetails.name: ACID RINSE TRANSFER PUMP
generalDetails.description: The acid rinse transfer pump is used to transfer acid rinse solution from storage or collection tanks to the required process tank. It ensures smooth and controlled liquid transfer, supporting effective rinsing and stable process operation.

generalDetails.name: FILTER PRESS SUPPLY PUMP
generalDetails.description: The filter press supply pump is used to feed sludge or process liquid to the filter press at the required pressure. It supports efficient solid-liquid separation, helping remove contaminants and maintain smooth system operation.

generalDetails.name: DUMP TANK TRANSFER PUMP
generalDetails.description: The dump tank transfer pump is used to transfer used or waste solution from the dump tank to storage, treatment, or disposal systems. It ensures efficient liquid handling, prevents overflow, and supports smooth process maintenance.

generalDetails.name: CLEANER  FEED MOTOR
generalDetails.description: The cleaner feed motor is used to drive the pump or feeder that supplies cleaner solution to the process tank. It ensures continuous and controlled chemical feeding, helping maintain proper concentration and effective cleaning performance.

generalDetails.name: CIRCULATION PUMP_PHOSPHATE
generalDetails.description: The circulation pump is used to continuously circulate the phosphate solution within the tank. It helps maintain uniform chemical concentration, steady flow, and consistent temperature, ensuring effective coating formation and stable process performance.

generalDetails.name: CIRCULATION PUMP_ACTIVATION
generalDetails.description: The circulation pump is used to continuously circulate the activation solution within the tank. It helps maintain uniform chemical distribution and steady flow, ensuring proper surface activation and consistent process performance.
